author: blonkevnoçy
text: the sooner you ditch that habit of annotating within tiny tabs, margins and line spacings, the better. keep a dedicated notebook/journal instead, been doing it for only five months and realized it's an infinitely more rewarding and versatile method for analysis and retention.

topReplies.author: blonkevnoçy
topReplies.text: write abstracts, arguments, condensed essays; draw conceptual maps, and sketch -- for yourself only, not for instagram or pinterest. it will always beat the practice of simply underlining texts and one-line commentaries on your book.

topReplies.author: r
topReplies.text: What do you do if you’re reading multiple books at once

topReplies.author: blonkevnoçy
topReplies.text:
i don't have a strict system since it's meant to be read and understood only by my eyes, so i write down thoughts as they appear. i enjoy it because it gives shape to my chronological thinking across multiple subjects.

but I don't usually read multiple books, to begin with.
